# Knos

> Ask anything about research. Knos answers with what is proved, by which test locked on NEAR testnet, and what is behind it.

Knos locks a test before any work starts, and test money moves to the agent that did the work only if that test passes. Here the work is code that proves a paper's claim, against a test locked on NEAR testnet. The result is kept on NEAR, so a second check is free. Test money only and no customers yet.

## Pages

- [Front door](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/): ask about research, see what is proved and by which locked test
- [Claims](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/claims/): every claim, sorted by the test USDC behind it
- [Prove](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/prove/): run the check of a claim and get the verdict, the verified code and the receipt
- [For agents](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/agents/): the one-call API and the terminal tool
- [For labs](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/labs/): the same check inside InterSystems IRIS
- [Check pull requests](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/check/): the pull request check, the same Knos built earlier on Solana devnet (Colosseum, tag v0.3.28)

## Claims

- [HyperLogLog counts 30,000 different visitors within 10% using at most 1.5 kilobytes of memory.](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/claim/hyperloglog/): from Flajolet, Fusy, Gandouet and Meunier, 2007; locked test sha256 55ef830ef15276e6b6bb75c249fb54eb09788f2fcee240bde2a293c066a29df3
- [Jump consistent hash moves only about 1 key in 11 when 10 buckets become 11, with nothing stored.](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/claim/jump-hash/): from Lamping and Veach, 2014; locked test sha256 ffa9d064744e7ea0cc326039f55a979a588e2c1cdb3f59368ff4a99c986057cb
- [An xor filter answers set membership with under 0.5% false positives in at most 10 bits per key, where a Bloom filter of that size cannot.](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/claim/xor-filter/): from Graf and Lemire, 2020; locked test sha256 ffd0f5571c8a0a3d415080949a10734a6743e9bf520786f58f94aa75077f6cf0
- [A Morris counter counts 100,000 events within 10% in a 12-bit register, where an exact count needs 17 bits.](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/claim/morris-counter/): from Nelson and Yu, 2020; locked test sha256 b91647f1caef8c6e09486ad022da7200724a806b1a2a0fe7ab9ee31ad20d7dab
- [The planet Kepler-10b goes around its star once every 0.837495 days, found again in NASA's public Kepler light curve.](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/claim/kepler-10b/): from Batalha and others, 2011; locked test sha256 ce84ea41cf052a82a12d092b17dedf56f91be6271839bdc599221536849464e6
- [Landsat 8's published orbit, 705 km up and tilted 98.2 degrees, is sun-synchronous: simulated with Earth's equatorial bulge, its orbit plane turns 0.98565 degrees a day.](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/claim/landsat-8-orbit/): from NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, page read 13 Nov 2026; locked test sha256 07f531b478698a5ce3997452cb94d31d96154a1f78260d32b611b7b971a69523
- [A plain Ridge regression predicts how many cycles NASA's simulated FD001 jet engines have left, off by 16.634 cycles RMS.](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/claim/cmapss-engine-life/): from Galchar, Goel and Kanu, 2026; locked test sha256 6b5933e65e3ad982a8a1790c264526b0f69b58741384c5b1e66b7cb2fd4f1bb7

## For agents

`POST https://knos.onrender.com/api/near/claim/flow` with `{"url": "https://doi.org/10.46298/dmtcs.3545", "amount": 10}`: the verdict, the code and the receipt.
